method: FFmpeg freezedetect on the 1080x740 canvas at (0,565), -80 dB noise threshold, minimum 2 seconds; excludes the static title/caption field
initialWholeFrameMethod: -60 dB over the entire image, minimum 2 seconds
diagnosis: The static title/caption field dominates the whole-frame average; native and encoded sampled images show moving packet positions. Final detection isolates the declared 3D viewport and uses -80 dB.
